column3: A person who must have specific knowledge of operating the machine.

A person who must possess professional knowledge enabling him to carry out work on the mechanical parts of the machine and its installations. The maintenance technician must have attended a machine training course held by PRIMA INDUSTRIE S.p.A.
PRIMA INDUSTRIE S.p.A.'s Technical Assistance Service personnel or in possession of a specific authorization from PRIMA INDUSTRIE S.p.A.'s Technical Assistance Service.
